page: Microsoft Azure DS2_v2 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The configuration includes 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 2 vCPUs. It is equipped with 7.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.5 GB of RAM per core, and includes 14 GB of local storage. The processor features a 48 MB L3 cache and supports AVX and AVX-512F instruction sets.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the DS2_v2 sits in the lower performance tiers for compute-heavy and memory-intensive tasks. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show weak to poor throughput, with uncached read speeds at 22.78 GB/sec and write speeds at 18.09 GB/sec. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in text generation for small language models (135M) at 94.89 tokens per second, though prompt processing remains weak.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the DS2_v2 represents a low-resource entry point within the DSv2 family. It offers a balanced but modest resource density suitable for lightweight workloads where high-throughput compute or massive memory footprints are not required. This virtual machine is best suited for basic web serving, small-scale database operations, lightweight background tasks, and development or testing environments.

This server is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for low-intensity workloads.
